name: Grade 11
theme: The sacraments and the moral life in Christ

lessons.title: Christ’s work in the liturgy
lessons.idea: The liturgy is the work of Christ and his Church. In it God sanctifies us and we worship him.
lessons.question: Why is liturgy more than a ritual?

lessons.title: Signs that give grace
lessons.idea: Sacraments are efficacious signs of grace instituted by Christ.
lessons.question: What does “ex opere operato” mean?
lessons.activity: Create a chart of matter and form.

lessons.title: Disposition and fruitfulness
lessons.idea: Fruitful reception depends on faith and disposition.
lessons.question: Why are dispositions important?

lessons.title: Baptism
lessons.idea: New birth in water and the Spirit.
lessons.question: Why baptize infants?
lessons.activity: Study the rite and address objections.

lessons.title: Confirmation
lessons.idea: Seal of the Spirit.
lessons.question: What do we receive?

lessons.title: Eucharist
lessons.idea: Source and summit.
lessons.question: Why did Jesus say flesh?

units.title: Healing: Reconciliation and Anointing
units.eq: How does Christ heal and forgive?

lessons.title: Sin and mercy
lessons.idea: Sin wounds. Mercy heals.
lessons.question: What is sin?

lessons.title: Confession
lessons.idea: Contrition, confession, satisfaction, absolution.
lessons.question: Why confess to a priest?

lessons.title: Anointing of the Sick
lessons.idea: Strength and comfort in illness.
lessons.question: Who may receive it?

units.title: Service: Orders and Matrimony
units.eq: How do sacraments build the Church?

lessons.title: Holy Orders
lessons.idea: Bishops, priests, deacons configured to Christ.
lessons.question: Why only men?

lessons.title: Marriage as a sacrament
lessons.idea: Covenant of love, faithful, permanent, fruitful.
lessons.question: Why is marriage indissoluble?

lessons.title: Family and vocation
lessons.idea: The family is the domestic church.
lessons.question: What makes a home holy?

lessons.title: The dignity of the person and the Beatitudes
lessons.idea: We are made for happiness.
lessons.question: Where is happiness found?

lessons.title: Freedom, conscience and natural law
lessons.idea: Freedom is for the good; conscience is the judge.
lessons.question: What is natural law?

lessons.title: Sin, virtue and grace
lessons.idea: Virtue is a habit of the good.
lessons.question: How do we grow in virtue?

units.title: The Commandments I: love of God

lessons.title: First commandment
lessons.idea: Worship God alone.
lessons.question: What are modern idols?

lessons.title: Second and third commandments
lessons.idea: Reverence for God’s name; keep the Lord’s Day.
lessons.question: How do we keep Sunday?

lessons.title: Prayer as response
lessons.idea: Prayer is the life of the new heart.
lessons.question: How do we pray?

units.title: The Commandments II: love of neighbor

lessons.title: Life and chastity
lessons.idea: The dignity of life and sexuality.
lessons.question: What does the Church teach about chastity?

lessons.title: Justice and truth
lessons.idea: Justice, honesty, and care of the poor.
lessons.question: How can we practice honesty?

lessons.title: Desire and detachment
lessons.idea: Purity of heart and generosity.
lessons.question: What does purity of heart mean?

units.title: Social teaching and conscience in action
units.eq: What does it mean to love in society?

lessons.title: Human dignity and the common good
lessons.idea: Society serves the person.
lessons.question: What is the common good?

lessons.title: Solidarity and the poor
lessons.idea: We are responsible for one another.
lessons.question: What is the option for the poor?

lessons.title: Creation and stewardship
lessons.idea: We care for God’s creation.
lessons.question: How can we care for creation?
